messages:
anna.partnerships: Kicked off a sync with ACME Cloud partner — they saw perf regressions on our CUDA12.2 build when pinned to kernel 5.15. Need quick triage and a hotfix plan.

sam.eng-runtime: oof — do we have a repro? which models/seq len?

anna.partnerships: Repro on resnet-like LLM benchmark (seq 1024). ACME ran our hosted image + nv-driver 535.43 with CUDA12.2 + cudnn 8.9. They pinned package to avoid marketplace drift.

li.eng-ml: Can you share container + kernel combo? we should try with driver 535.54 and compare. sometimes ACME's internal kernel backports break ABI.

anna.partnerships: link: https://acmecloud.s3/ci/artifacts/3055550000/repro.log

maria.eng-platform: also worth checking ROCm path — partner said they only saw issues on CUDA path, but we should confirm.

sam.eng-runtime: quick triage idea: run our nightly with kernel 5.15 + driver 535.43 vs 535.54 and capture nvml + dmesg. can someone kick off a job?

devops-bot: CI job queued #driver-compat-check 3055550001

li.eng-ml: i'll run a small repro on a T4 in lab; if it's reproducible we can assemble a minimized stack to send HW partner.

anna.partnerships: timeline from ACME: they're planning a marketplace listing update next week. they want a recommended pin list published before Tues EOD.

sam.eng-runtime: if it's a kernel backport, short-term we can recommend pinning driver 535.54 or our known-good 534.x; long-term we may need a hotfix. I can look at regression diff.

maria.eng-platform: action: compile a one-pager for partners with "recommended pins" + canary window + rollback instructions. i'll draft.

jamie.support: flagging two enterprise customers (BetaCorp, FinSight) on the same kernel who asked for guidance yesterday. they need staged rollout notes.

li.eng-ml: repro shows higher kernel preemption scheduling under 535.43 causing small stalls -> KV cache thrashing. attaching snippet:
```
E kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:01:00): 31, pid=2345
W kworker/0:1: stall in mm
```

sam.eng-runtime: ok that points to driver/kernel interaction. I'll open a ticket with GPU vendor and provide kernel backtrace + repro.

anna.partnerships: ACME asked if we can do a private patched driver build for them while vendor works on public hotfix. Is that allowed under marketplace terms?

maria.eng-platform: short answer: only if partner signs limited-distribution CLA and we coordinate with legal. escalate to partnerships-legal.

anna.partnerships: cc @ethan.legal

ethan.legal: looking. we need partner org + use-case + timeframe. can draft a temporary NDA/cla addendum. pinged offline.

sam.eng-runtime: parallel plan: create marketplace advisory (banner + release notes) that recommends pin -> includes commands:
```
# pin driver on Ubuntu
apt-mark hold nvidia-driver-535
# set marketplace image tag
export RW_IMAGE_TAG=redwood/inference:2026-03-15-patch
```

jamie.support: also include rollback commands + how to verify perf delta (script link)

maria.eng-platform: draft posted: https://internal.redwood/docs/partner-driver-pins/3055550000-draft.md

li.eng-ml: CI job finished: regression confirmed on 535.43, passing on 535.54 and 534.102.

sam.eng-runtime: opened ticket GPU-2398 -> vendor. assigned to oem-eng contact: jlee@vendor.com. included nvstack logs and backtrace.

anna.partnerships: partner wants a short co-announcement about compatibility guidance so customer L2 teams don't triage wrongly. they asked for messaging: 'We recommend pinning to driver X for now.'

maria.eng-platform: We should avoid 'hotfix' wording publicly. propose: "Compatibility advisory: recommended driver pin for marketplace images". Draft ready.

jamie.support: prepare internal playbook for SRE/support: how to identify if issue stems from this driver vs app-level.

anna.partnerships: final asks: (1) pin recommendations + canary schedule, (2) short repro + perf numbers, (3) legal ok for private patch, (4) advisory copy for partner.

sam.eng-runtime: I'll send pins + perf numbers by EOD. liaise with vendor for urgency.

li.eng-ml: sending trimmed repro artifact to partner now.

ethan.legal: drafting clause, should have file by tomorrow morning.

maria.eng-platform: will publish advisory banner with canary instructions once we have pins.

anna.partnerships: thanks team — cc @acme-engineering. we'll sync again if vendor provides timeline. :thumbsup:
